name: Card Transaction Authorisation — Suspicious Activity Block (Geographic Impossibility)
description: Exception path sequence showing post-authorisation suspicious activity detection. Two approved transactions are authorised from geographically impossible locations within 3 minutes. SVC-013 detects the geographic impossibility pattern after consuming the second EVT-065. SVC-013 publishes EVT-068 (SuspiciousCardActivityDetected) with recommended_action = block_card. SVC-011 blocks the card in its local cache. Subsequent authorisation attempts are declined. Fraud Analyst (PER-054) investigates and confirms genuine card compromise. Key design point: both transactions are already approved before the pattern is detected — post-auth fraud detection cannot reverse already-issued authorisations.
key_design_points: Real-time authorisation path does NOT involve SVC-013 — fraud rules in local cache only
Post-auth pattern detection is async and cannot block already-issued authorisations
EVT-068 payload does NOT include decline_reason or raw risk_score in SVC-103 audit log
Customer notification uses generic 'unusual activity' language — no fraud pattern disclosed
SVC-011 card block propagates immediately to local cache — next auth attempt declined within 500ms

steps.action: ISO 8583 Auth Request #1 — card used in country A (GB)
Response: APPROVED (00)
Publish EVT-065 CardAuthorisationCompleted #1
Deliver EVT-065 #1 — velocity counter updated
ISO 8583 Auth Request #2 — same card, 3 minutes later, country B (DE)
Response: APPROVED (00)
Publish EVT-065 CardAuthorisationCompleted #2
Deliver EVT-065 #2 — cross-transaction pattern analysis triggered
Evaluate cross-transaction pattern: geographic impossibility detected — GB and DE within 3 minutes (physical travel impossible). risk_score=0.97, recommended_action=block_card.
Publish EVT-068 SuspiciousCardActivityDetected
Deliver EVT-068 to audit log — risk_score redacted in SVC-103 entry
steps.data: card_number_token, pattern_type=geographic_impossibility, recommended_action=block_card, affected_transactions=[auth_id_1, auth_id_2] (risk_score omitted)

steps.action: Deliver EVT-068 — recommended_action=block_card
Update local card status cache: card_number_token status set to suspended_fraud_investigation
Deliver EVT-068 to fraud case management (INTL-003) — full risk_score and pattern_type visible to PER-054
steps.data: card_number_token, pattern_type=geographic_impossibility, risk_score=0.97, affected_transactions=[auth_id_1, auth_id_2], recommended_action=block_card

steps.action: Deliver EVT-068 — trigger customer notification
Dispatch push notification (CH-002) — generic 'unusual activity' language, no fraud pattern disclosed
steps.data: push_notification: 'Unusual activity detected. Card temporarily blocked. Call fraud line if you need assistance.'

steps.action: ISO 8583 Auth Request #3 — same card (post-block attempt)
Check local card status cache — card is suspended_fraud_investigation, decline immediately
Response: DECLINED (D05 — Do Not Honour)
Publish EVT-066 CardAuthorisationDeclined — no decline_reason in payload
PER-054 reviews case in INTL-003: inspects transaction timeline, MCC patterns, and geographic impossibility. Confirms genuine card compromise.
steps.data: case review: auth_id_1 (GB), auth_id_2 (DE), 3-minute interval — confirmed physical impossibility, card compromised

steps.action: PATCH /card-status/{card_number_token} — action=maintain_block (card remains suspended pending replacement)
Initiate card replacement workflow
